scope: Interpretation of root-owned hardware capture plus isolated A76 trial preparation; no hardware access by this agent.

frequency_decode.modulation: PAT0=0/PAT1=0x30000000 enable no PI/SDM/fractional modes; LFM=0x40000001 has bit31=0, so no LFM frequency modulation. CTRL/STAT match. Rates are decoded programmed clock rates, not instrument measurements.

cpu_identity.crosscheck: evidence/live-board-20261112/capture.log processor0..5 part0xd05 and processor6..7 part0xd0b; all8 online in that historical capture.

opp_source.constraint: CPU_B_PLL manual VCO650MHz..2.26GHz; donor26MHz minimum N26 means VCO>=676MHz. Do not merely enable default N20 (520MHzVCO) or copy ROM A55 N19.

actions.audit: default; CPU registers read only, PMIC via existing owner API
actions.enable: requires CPU6/7offline, holds cpus_read_lock through mutation, verifies current CPU A55, 26MHz RTC flag, exact measured B state, no modulation, both CPU rails on, no joined phases, DCDC3/4 selectors800..1100mV
actions.restore: explicit exact original slow/disabledPLL state; also requires CPU6/7offline and target-state match. Voltage read/check failure does not block reducing to slow.
actions.rmmod: no hardware write; retains setting to avoid changing clocks during online tests

trial.pmic: symbol_get(t736_pmic_read_cpu_supplies), six-byte stable struct from boards/t736-pmic.h, serialized by existing owner. No duplicated TWI mapping/engine or PMIC voltage write.
sequence: Set external/2 while mux remains slow
Program stoppedPLL N32 and commit UPDATE with bounded clear timeout
KeepLDO, enablePLL and lock detector, commitUPDATE, require3consecutive lock reads
Enableoutput while stillslow, commitUPDATE again and require3consecutive lock reads, verifyCTRL+CTRL_STAT, switchmux last, verify target and unchanged A55/DSU/back/modulation guards
Re-read PMIC setpoints; failure rollsB only back to original slow state
trial.recovery: Rollback confirms slowmux readback before disablingPLL. Incomplete restore logs critical and requires CPU6/7remainoffline. No unrelated register is restored/written.
trial.build: W=1 compile completed against updated6.18.63-t736-gpu-v15; no warnings.
trial.future_frequency: 1014MHz is not exposed by this module; first verify416MHz hardware independently.
peer_review: code_index: read-only logic review found no blocker; did not independently verify register/manual formulas
event_review: PMIC/offline/exact-state/rollback guards confirmed; added OUTPUT UPDATE+lock before final CTRL_STAT/mux validation to match CPU-specific donor probe

limitations: Explains severe A76 execution slowdown but does not establish that every visible flicker is CPU-caused. PMIC registers report setpoints/enable, not analog voltage measurement.
